Lower Text: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] Your opponent may trash 1 card in their hand. If they didn't trash, you may play 1 level 3 purple Digimon card from your trash without paying the cost.
Upper Text: [When Digivolving] [On Deletion] If your opponent has 5 or fewer cards in their hand, gain 1 memory. If they have 7 or more, they trash 1 card in their hand.
